text:
noah (PM): Pushed a tiny prototype for compact chat controls focusing on streaming token UX: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/compact-stream-experiments

maria (Design): Nice. Two quick nits: token badge contrast and cramped stop/regenerate spacing when width < 320px. Recommend icon-only with visible tooltip.

sam (Eng): For perf we'll show approximate during stream ("~42") and swap to exact on completion. Approx uses ceil(char_len/4). Avoid recomputing heavy tokenization each chunk.

jia (DevEx): Accessibility: make sure the visual "~42" has aria-label="approximately 42 tokens". Use a sr-only live region with aria-live="polite" to announce final count: "Generation complete  final token count: 42". Throttle updates to 300ms.

maria (Design): Copy options in fig: tooltip "Interrupt (Esc)" vs "Pause (Esc)". I prefer "Interrupt". Also adjusted swatches to hit 4.5:1.

sam (Eng): Keyboard: Esc -> interrupt, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter -> regenerate. Mobile: long-press bubble shows actions, with a one-time hint toast.

qa-bot: Ran quick accessibility smoke. Fail: live region announcements too frequent on VoiceOver. Suggested throttle >250ms and aria-atomic=true.

jia (DevEx): Good catch. I'll add aria-atomic and 300ms throttle. Also will ensure focus styles visible in high-contrast modes.

noah (PM): Great. Maria, add compact spacing variations. Sam/jia, can you pair on a small PR with the aria snippets? Target merge tomorrow. Thanks :thumbsup:
